{{Quote|Troubled is the planet Mon Calamari. Its races have divided. The droid army of the Quarren Isolation League moves against the Calamari Council. Alone, the Calamari are no match. Intervene we must!|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]|<ref name="V" />}}
The '''Battle of Mon Calamari''' was a battle fought between the aquatic [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] and [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] races on the planet [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Their secessionist ideals represented by the [[Quarren Isolation League/Legends|Quarren Isolation League]], backed by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and bolstered by the telepathic abilities of the indigenous [[Moappa]] species, the Quarren attempted to seize control of the planet from the [[Mon Calamari Council|Calamari Council]], who were backed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. When the Quarren proceeded to launch an attack on the Calamari people, the Republic sent an aquatic detachment of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] to quell the threat.

Fisto himself was chosen by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] to participate in the battle due to being a member of the aquatic [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] race. Fisto led his [[Clone SCUBA trooper/Legends|clone SCUBA troopers]] against the [[manta droid subfighter]]s and other aquatic weapons of the Separatists, which were commanded by a [[Unidentified Quarren commander|Quarren warlord]]. The warlord himself eventually participated in the battle from the bridge of a [[crab cannon]], which turned the tides of the battle against the Republic: the cannon had the ability to destroy an entire [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|Republic assault ship]] floating on the surface of the ocean. The combined might of the Republic and the [[Mon Calamari Knights/Legends|Mon Calamari Knights]] managed to destroy the crab cannon and subdue the Quarren forces.

==Prelude==
The [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] and [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] had coexisted on the planet [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]; however, their relationship had always been in shaky waters. The Quarren anger, mistrust, and jealousy against the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] people had grown within the ranks of their neighbors, the collective intelligence of the [[Moappa]]. The Quarren Isolation League was established to counter the apparent Mon Calamari domination over the Quarren race.<ref name="V" />

Eventually, [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] intervened in the political turmoil, pledging support to the Quarren secessionist movement.<ref name="I">{{CW|1}}</ref> Now backed by a [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]], the Quarren moved against the Mon Calamari, intending to start [[civil war]]. Unwilling to lose a powerful ally in the Mon Calamari people, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] sent a detachment of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] to assist the Mon Calamari.<ref name="V" />

==The battle==
[[File:Battle_of_Mon_Cal_TCWCG.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] destroys a manta droid subfighter.]]
{{Quote|Master Fisto, in these matters trust your insight we do. May the Force be with you.|Yoda|<ref name="V" />}}
At the beginning of hostilities, the Quarren Isolation League moved against Calamari cities with the help of CIS [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. The Calamari were quickly reinforced by Fisto's fleet of [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]], which landed in the broad oceans of Dac. From his command ship, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] leaped into battle with an army of [[Clone SCUBA trooper/Legends|Clone SCUBA troopers]], engaging the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] army in its own element.<ref name="V" />

The battle eventually settled around a large self-propelled [[Crab cannon|artillery cannon]]. It managed to fire two shots, destroying one [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] before Kit Fisto was able to destroy the cannon's legs with massive force bubbles. With the aid of the native [[Mon Calamari Knights/Legends|Mon Calamari Knights]], the gun was pushed over the edge of a chasm and destroyed.<ref name="V" /> The fighting continued for several more days as the elusive [[Moappa]] [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic]] swarm consciousness continued its command of the Quarren, angered by the Mon Calamari's arrogance in claiming their planet for themselves.

[[File:Moncalamariknights.jpg|thumb|180px|The [[Mon Calamari Knights/Legends|Mon Calamari Knights]] ride into battle mounted on [[Keelkana/Legends|keelkana]].]]
Fisto destroyed several Quarren outposts, and interrogated survivors as to the whereabouts of their commander. Having found that all the Quarren soldiers received their commands telepathically, he managed to locate the Moappa, engage them in combat, and learn of their intentions. Dispersing the Moappa to such a degree as to deny them their collective intelligence, Fisto returned to the Mon Calamari victorious.

==Aftermath==
Fisto advised the Mon Calamari to use their diplomatic techniques to deal with the Moappa's demands; by this time heavy conflict had died down to a halt. Although the Mon Calamari had emerged victorious over their Quarren adversaries, reunification of the planet did not last long. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the warlord [[Riff Tamson/Legends|Riff Tamson]], a benefactor of Count Dooku, assassinated [[King/Legends|King]] [[Yos Kolina/Legends|Yos Kolina]], leaving the young and inexperienced [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Lee-Char/Legends|Lee-Char]] to claim the throne. This angered the Quarren people, who once again decided to attack the Mon Calamari people in what became known as the [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|Battle of Mon Cala]].<ref name="WW">{{TCW|Water War}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
After being teased in [[Chapter 1 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|the first installment]] of ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'', the Battle of Mon Calamari was featured in "[[Chapter 5 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|Chapter 5]]" of the series. The conflict was also playable from the perspective of Kit Fisto in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars: Planetary Forces]]''.
